title: squabble gate document (squabble-contract/1.0.0)
description: The document `squabble fetch <owner>/<repo> <pr>` writes to stdout. One entry per required context, with the run bound to it on the head commit. A context whose run is `passed` is the only evidence-bearing satisfied state.

checks.description: The required-context set. An empty array is a valid document and is NEVER green: an unprotected gate is Blocked, not won.

required_context.description: The exact, case-sensitive context name the branch ruleset requires.

run.description: The realised run. CANCELLED/TIMED_OUT/STARTUP_FAILURE/ERROR/ACTION_REQUIRED/STALE and unrecognised conclusions map to `failed`. SKIPPED/NEUTRAL map to `skipped`: the ruleset accepts it, no evidence is carried.

missing_cause.description: Why a context is `missing`. Diagnosis only: it never changes `run` and never moves the gate state.
